chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abu Hammam, from Suleiman al-Ja'fari, from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:
The best sustenance is al-sawiq; if you are hungry, it stays (in the stomach), and if you are satiated, it digests your food.

key_terms.السَّوِيقُ: A traditional food made from roasted flour, often mixed with water or milk; a type of flour soup or porridge.

ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits of al-sawiq according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) highlights the benefits of al-sawiq (a traditional flour-based soup or porridge) as an ideal food, noting its gentle nature on the stomach. It stays longer when one is hungry and aids digestion when one is already full. This hadith reflects the Shia emphasis on moderate, easily digestible foods that promote physical well-being and spiritual clarity, aligning with the Prophet's tradition of simplicity in diet.
